briefdescription.para: Percolator-style commit for SNAPSHOT_ISOLATION transactions.

detaileddescription.para:
Executes cross-shard conflict detection and TrueTime-anchored commit for snapshot-isolated transactions. The full sequence is:
Prepare phase — all participants vote COMMIT or ABORT (conflict check). Any ABORT vote triggers abort of all prepared participants and returns false.
Derive commit timestamp via TrueTime::now_with_uncertainty().latest.
Perform commit-wait: spin until TT.now().earliest > commit_ts.
Send COMMIT to all participants with the agreed timestamp.
This path is chosen when Config::use_percolator_for_snapshot == true and the transaction's isolation_level == SNAPSHOT_ISOLATION.

txn
Distributed transaction (state mutated in-place).
True if all participants prepared and committed successfully.
txn
Input/output parameter.
True when the operation succeeds.
Calls: preparePhase(), THEMIS_WARN(), sendAbort(), now_with_uncertainty(), THEMIS_DEBUG(), count(), waitUntil(), emplace_back().
